datasets.description: Proportion of population living in 1, 5 and 10km buffer zones for Pacific Island Countries and Territories, determined using most recent Population and Housing Census. lineage.description: Coastal population data derived from most recent Population and Housing Census for Pacific Island Countries and Territories, with population projections used to apportion census counts into 1, 5, and 10km coastal buffer zones. This dataset identifies populations at risk from coastal hazards by quantifying settlement patterns in proximity to the coast.
